title.zh: 卷二十 本紀第二十 神宗一
title.raw: 卷二十 本紀第二十 神宗一 Volume 20 Annals 20: Shenzong 1

sentences.zh: 神宗，範天合道哲肅敦簡光文章武安仁止孝顯皇帝，諱翊鈞，穆宗第三子也。

translations.literal: Shenzong, the Emperor of Embracing Heaven, Uniting the Way, Sagacious and Solemn, Sincere and Simple, Brilliant in Culture, Glorious in Martial Accomplishment, Secure in Benevolence, Resting in Filial Piety and Manifest Brightness, taboo name Yijun, was Muzong's third son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shenzong—honored after death as one who embraced Heaven, united the Way, and united sagacious solemnity, sincere simplicity, brilliant culture, glorious martial accomplishment, secure benevolence, resting filial piety, and manifest brightness—was named Zhu Yijun and was the third son of Emperor Muzong.

sentences.zh: 母貴妃李氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Consort Li of the Gui rank.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Consort Li, of the Gui rank.

sentences.zh: 隆慶二年，立為皇太子，時方六歲。

translations.literal: In Longqing year two, he was invested as crown prince; he was then six years old.
translations.idiomatic: In Longqing two he was made crown prince at the age of six.

sentences.zh: 穆宗嘗馳馬宮中，諫曰：「陛下天下主，獨騎而騁，寧無銜橛憂。

translations.literal: Once when Muzong was galloping his horse in the palace grounds, [the crown prince] remonstrated, saying: "Your Majesty is lord of all under Heaven; riding alone at full speed, is there not fear of a bit-shy?
translations.idiomatic: Once when Muzong was racing his horse through the palace, the crown prince remonstrated: "Your Majesty is sovereign of the realm; galloping alone, might you not shy at the bit and come to harm?

sentences.zh: 」穆宗喜，下馬勞之。

translations.literal: " Muzong was pleased and dismounted to commend him.
translations.idiomatic: Muzong was pleased, dismounted, and praised him.

sentences.zh: 陳皇后病居別宮，每晨隨貴妃候起居。

translations.literal: Empress Chen, ill, lived in a separate palace; each morning [the crown prince] accompanied Consort Li to inquire after her health.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Chen, who was ill and lived apart, received the crown prince each morning when he came with Consort Li to inquire after her.

sentences.zh: 后聞履聲輒喜，為強起。

translations.literal: When the empress heard their footsteps she was always pleased and would force herself to rise.
translations.idiomatic: At the sound of their footsteps the empress would brighten and rouse herself despite her illness.

sentences.zh: 取經書問之，無不響答，貴妃亦喜。

translations.literal: He would take up the classics and be questioned; he answered every question without fail, and Consort Li was also pleased.
translations.idiomatic: She would take up the classics and question him; he answered every point without hesitation, and Consort Li was delighted.

sentences.zh: 由是兩宮益和。

translations.literal: From this the two palaces grew ever more harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: From this the two palaces grew closer in harmony.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，穆宗崩。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of year six, Muzong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Longqing six Muzong died.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yimao new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the yimao new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 甲子，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On jiazi he ascended the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 以明年為萬曆元年，詔赦天下。

translations.literal: The following year was declared Wanli year one, and an edict proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The court declared the following year Wanli one and issued an amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 祀建文朝盡節諸臣於鄉學，有苗裔者恤錄。

translations.literal: Men of Jianwen's reign who died maintaining their integrity were sacrificed to at district schools; descendants were granted relief and enrollment.
translations.idiomatic: The court sacrificed to Jianwen-era officials who had died maintaining their integrity at district schools, and granted relief and enrollment to surviving descendants.

sentences.zh: 庚午，罷高拱。

translations.literal: On gengwu Gao Gong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Gao Gong was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，高儀卒。

translations.literal: On dingchou Gao Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Gao Yi died.

sentences.zh: 壬午，禮部尚書呂調陽兼文淵閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: On renwu Minister of Rites Lü Diaoyang was concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Lü Diaoyang, minister of rites, was also made grand secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion and entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，初通漕運於密雲。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dinghai: grain transport by canal was first opened to Miyun.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dinghai, canal transport of tribute grain was first extended to Miyun.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，察京官。

translations.literal: On gengyin capital officials were inspected.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the court inspected capital officials.

sentences.zh: 己亥，戒諭廷臣，詔曰：「近歲以來，士習澆漓，官方刓缺，詆老成為無用，矜便佞為有才。

translations.literal: On jihai court ministers were admonished; the edict said: "In recent years scholars' habits have grown corrupt and shallow, and official integrity has been worn away; the experienced are decried as useless and the glib flatterer is prized as talented.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the emperor admonished the court; the edict read: "In recent years scholarly conduct has grown corrupt and shallow, official integrity has been eroded, the seasoned are mocked as useless, and the glib flatterer is praised as able.

sentences.zh: 遂使朝廷威福之柄，徒為人臣報復之資。

translations.literal: Thus the court's authority to reward and punish has become merely a resource for ministers' private vengeance.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the court's power to reward and punish has become nothing but a weapon for ministers' private revenge.

sentences.zh: 用是薄示懲戒，餘皆曲貸。

translations.literal: For this reason light punishments have been shown; the rest have been graciously pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Accordingly light punishments have been imposed; the rest have been leniently forgiven.

sentences.zh: 諸臣宜祓除前愆，共維新政。

translations.literal: All ministers should cleanse themselves of past faults and together uphold the new policy.
translations.idiomatic: All ministers should purge past faults and together uphold the new order.

sentences.zh: 若溺於故習，背公徇私，獲罪祖宗，朕不敢赦。

translations.literal: If you cling to old habits, betray the public for private ends, and incur guilt before the ancestors, I will not grant pardon."
translations.idiomatic: If you sink back into old habits, betray the public for private gain, and offend the ancestors, I will not pardon you."

sentences.zh: 」庚子，尊皇后曰「仁聖皇太后」，貴妃曰「慈聖皇太后」。

translations.literal: On gengzi the empress was honored as "Empress Dowager Rensheng" and the consort as "Empress Dowager Cisheng."
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the empress was honored as Empress Dowager Rensheng and Consort Li as Empress Dowager Cisheng.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，祀大社大稷。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuwu: the Great Earth and Great Grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuwu, the court sacrificed to the Great Earth and Great Grain.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，葬莊皇帝於昭陵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiawu: the Zhuang Emperor was buried at Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiawu, the late Muzong was buried at Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，侍郎王遴、吳百朋、汪道昆分閱邊防。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiwei: Vice Ministers Wang Lin, Wu Baipeng, and Wang Daokun separately inspected frontier defenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiwei, Vice Ministers Wang Lin, Wu Baipeng, and Wang Daokun were dispatched to inspect frontier defenses separately.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，停刑。

translations.literal: On xinyou executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，河工成。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiwei: Yellow River works were completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiwei, work on the Yellow River was completed.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，振榆林、延綏饑。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinyou: relief was granted for famine in Yulin and Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, the court granted famine relief in Yulin and Yan-sui.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以大行未期，罷明年元夕燈火及宮中宴。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, because the late emperor's mourning period was not yet complete, the Lantern Festival lights and palace banquets for the coming year were canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, because mourning for the late emperor was not yet complete, Lantern Festival illuminations and palace banquets for the coming year were canceled.

sentences.zh: 萬曆元年春二月癸丑，御經筵。

translations.literal: Wanli year one, spring, second month, day guichou: the emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Wanli one, on guichou of the second month, the emperor attended the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，詔內外官舉將材。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingshen: an edict ordered officials within and without the capital to recommend military talent.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingshen, an edict ordered officials throughout the realm to recommend military talent.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，潮、惠賊平。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yichou: bandits in Chao and Hui were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yichou, bandits in Chaozhou and Huizhou were pacified.

sentences.zh: 庚午，諭百官修省。

translations.literal: On gengwu officials were admonished to undertake self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the emperor admonished officials to undertake self-examination.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，詔內外官慎刑獄。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiashen: an edict ordered officials within and without the capital to be careful with criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiashen, an edict ordered officials throughout the realm to handle criminal cases with care.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，振淮安水災。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renshen: relief was granted for flood disaster in Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renshen, the court granted relief for flooding in Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，河決徐州。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: the Yellow River breached at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn the Yellow River breached at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，振荊州、承天及濟南災。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guwei: relief was granted for disasters in Jingzhou, Chengtian, and Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guwei, the court granted disaster relief in Jingzhou, Chengtian, and Jinan.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，四川都掌蠻平。

translations.literal: On bingxu the Duzhang tribes of Sichuan were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the Duzhang tribes of Sichuan were pacified.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，停刑。

translations.literal: On guimao executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月庚辰，命諸司立程限文簿，以防稽緩。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day gengchen: all offices were ordered to establish deadline registers to guard against delay.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on gengchen, all offices were ordered to keep deadline ledgers to prevent bureaucratic delay.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，振遼東饑。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiwei: relief was granted for famine in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiwei, the court granted famine relief in Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year Siam and Ryukyu entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Siam and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲午，召見朝覲廉能官於皇極門。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day jiawu: incorrupt and capable officials who had come to court audience were summoned for audience at the Huangji Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Wanli two, on jiawu of the first month, incorrupt and capable officials attending court audience were summoned to audience at the Huangji Gate.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，振四川被寇諸縣。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiayin: relief was granted to counties in Sichuan that had suffered raids.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiayin, the court granted relief to Sichuan counties ravaged by bandits.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，賜孫繼臯等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, day guisi: jinshi titles, palace degrees, and provincial degrees were granted to Sun Jigao and others according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guisi, the palace examination was held; Sun Jigao and others received jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and provincial degrees according to merit.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅，詔內外官行久任之法。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingyin: an edict ordered officials within and without the capital to implement the long-tenure policy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingyin, an edict ordered officials throughout the realm to implement long tenure in office.

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑，穆宗神主祔太廟。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinchou: Muzong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinchou, Muzong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，振山西災。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jisi: relief was granted for disasters in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jisi, the court granted disaster relief in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 庚午，振淮、揚、徐水災。

translations.literal: On gengwu relief was granted for flood disasters in Huai, Yang, and Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the court granted relief for floods in Huai, Yang, and Xu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，決囚。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiayin: prisoners were judged.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiayin, the court reviewed and judged prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，視朝閱銓選。

translations.literal: On dingmao the emperor held court and reviewed personnel selection.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the emperor held court and personally reviewed appointments.

sentences.zh: 閏十二月庚寅，詔罷明年元夕燈火。

translations.literal: Intercalary twelfth month, day gengyin: an edict canceled Lantern Festival lights for the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary twelfth month, on gengyin, an edict canceled Lantern Festival illuminations for the coming year.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁未，享太廟。

translations.literal: Year three, spring, first month, day dingwei: sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Wanli three, on dingwei of the first month, the court offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，祀大社大稷。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuyin: the Great Earth and Great Grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuyin, the court sacrificed to the Great Earth and Great Grain.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔南京職務清簡，官不必備。

translations.literal: On xinsi an edict stated that Nanjing posts were light in duty and offices need not be fully staffed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi an edict declared that Nanjing duties were light and full staffing was unnecessary.

sentences.zh: 丙申，始命日講官分直記註起居，纂緝章奏，臨朝侍班。

translations.literal: On bingshen daily lecture officials were first ordered to take rotating shifts recording the emperor's daily activities, compiling memorials, and attending court in service.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the court first ordered daily lecture officials to rotate in recording the emperor's movements, compiling memorials, and attending court in attendance.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳朔，日有食之，既。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jisi new moon: there was a total solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jisi new moon, there was a total solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬申，書謹天戒、任賢能、親賢臣、遠嬖佞、明賞罰、謹出入、慎起居、節飲食、收放心、存敬畏、納忠言、節財用十二事於座右，以自警。

translations.literal: On renshen twelve maxims—Revere Heaven's warnings, employ the worthy and able, keep close to worthy ministers, keep distant from favorites and flatterers, make rewards and punishments clear, be careful in going out and coming in, be cautious in daily conduct, restrain food and drink, gather in a wandering mind, preserve reverent awe, accept loyal counsel, and economize state expenditure—were written at the right of the seat for self-warning.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the emperor wrote twelve admonitions at his right hand to warn himself: revere Heaven's warnings, employ the worthy, keep close to good ministers, keep distant from favorites and flatterers, clarify rewards and punishments, be careful in comings and goings, be cautious in daily conduct, restrain food and drink, gather in a wandering mind, preserve reverent awe, accept loyal counsel, and economize state expenditure.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，淮、揚大水，詔察二府有司，貪酷老疾者罷之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengzi: great floods in Huai and Yang; an edict ordered inspection of officials in the two prefectures, and the greedy, cruel, aged, and infirm were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengzi, Huai and Yang suffered great floods; the court ordered inspection of officials in both prefectures and dismissed those who were greedy, cruel, aged, or infirm.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，浙江海溢。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuchen: the sea overflowed in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuchen, the sea overflowed in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命撫、按官，有司賢否一體薦劾，不得偏重甲科。

translations.literal: On wuyin censor-in-chief and surveillance commissioners were ordered to recommend and impeach local officials together on merit regardless of jinshi pedigree, without favoring palace graduates.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin provincial censors were ordered to recommend and impeach local officials on merit without favoring jinshi graduates.

sentences.zh: 是夏，蘇、松、常、鎮大水。

translations.literal: That summer Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang were struck by great floods.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丙子，禮部侍郎張四維為禮部尚書兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day bingzi: Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Siwei was made Minister of Rites and concurrent Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, joining deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on bingzi, Zhang Siwei, vice minister of rites, was made minister of rites and also grand secretary of the Eastern Pavilion and entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，河決高郵、碭山。

translations.literal: On dingchou the Yellow River breached at Gaoyou and Dangshan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the Yellow River breached at Gaoyou and Dangshan.

sentences.zh: 戊子，免淮、揚、鳳、徐被水田租。

translations.literal: On wuzi land tax on flooded fields in Huai, Yang, Feng, and Xu was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi land tax was remitted on flooded fields in Huai, Yang, Feng, and Xu.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，京師地震。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuwu: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuwu, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，地再震，敕群臣修省。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingmao: the earth shook again; the emperor ordered the court to undertake self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingmao, the earth shook again; the emperor ordered the court to undertake self-examination.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，停刑。

translations.literal: On wuchen executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，祀天於南郊。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yisi: Heaven was sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yisi, the court sacrificed to Heaven at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，詔罷明年元夕燈火。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinwei: an edict canceled Lantern Festival lights for the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinwei, an edict canceled Lantern Festival illuminations for the coming year.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、琉球、暹羅、土魯番入貢。

translations.literal: That year Annam, Ryukyu, Siam, and Turpan entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam, Ryukyu, Siam, and Turpan sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丁巳，遼東巡按御史劉臺以論張居正逮下獄，削籍。

translations.literal: Year four, spring, first month, day dingsi: Liaodong touring censor Liu Tai, for memorializing against Zhang Juzheng, was arrested and imprisoned, then stripped of registry.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Wanli four, on dingsi of the first month, Liaodong touring censor Liu Tai, for memorializing against Zhang Juzheng, was arrested, imprisoned, and stripped of official registry.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊申，祀地於北郊。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day wushen: the earth was sacrificed to at the Northern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on wushen, the court sacrificed to the earth at the Northern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，復遣內臣督蘇、杭織造。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengchen: eunuchs were again dispatched to supervise weaving in Suzhou and Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengchen, eunuchs were again dispatched to supervise Suzhou and Hangzhou imperial weaving.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉工語言學派中，影響最大的首推以石裏克、卡爾納著等為代，諭吏、戶二部清吏治，蠲逋賦有差，明年漕糧折收十之三。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingyou: the Ministries of Personnel and Revenue were admonished to cleanse official conduct; arrears in tax were remitted by degree, and next year's canal grain was to be collected in cash at three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingyou, the emperor admonished the Ministries of Personnel and Revenue to cleanse official conduct, remitted tax arrears by degree, and ordered that one-third of next year's canal tribute grain be collected in cash.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，遣御史督修江、浙水利。

translations.literal: On renyin censors were dispatched to supervise waterworks in Jiang and Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin censors were dispatched to supervise waterworks in Jiangsu and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，修泗州祖陵。

translations.literal: On jiachen the imperial ancestral tomb at Sizhou was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the imperial ancestral tomb at Sizhou was repaired.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，草灣河工成。

translations.literal: On xinhai works on the Caowan River were completed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai work on the Caowan River was completed.

sentences.zh: 八月壬戌，釋奠於先師孔子。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renxu: libation was offered to Confucius, the supreme teacher.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renxu, libation was offered to Confucius, the supreme teacher.

sentences.zh: 是秋，河決崔鎮。

translations.literal: That autumn the Yellow River breached at Cuizhen.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the Yellow River breached at Cuizhen.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，振徐州及豐、沛、睢寧、金鄉、魚臺、單、曹七縣水災，蠲租有差。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yihai: relief for flood disasters in Xuzhou and seven counties Feng, Pei, Suining, Jinxiang, Yutai, Shan, and Cao; rent remitted according to degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yihai, the court granted flood relief in Xuzhou and seven counties—Feng, Pei, Suining, Jinxiang, Yutai, Shan, and Cao—and remitted rent by degree.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、琉球、烏斯藏、土魯番、天方、撒馬兒罕、魯迷、哈密入貢。

translations.literal: That year Annam, Ryukyu, U-Tsang, Turpan, Tianfang, Samarkand, Rumi, and Hami entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam, Ryukyu, U-Tsang, Turpan, Tianfang, Samarkand, Rumi, and Hami sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月己酉，詔鳳陽、淮安力舉營田。

translations.literal: Year five, spring, first month, day jiyou: an edict ordered Fengyang and Huai'an to vigorously promote farming reclaimed lands.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Wanli five, on jiyou of the first month, an edict ordered Fengyang and Huai'an to vigorously promote land reclamation and farming.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，振廣西饑。

translations.literal: Second month, day yichou: relief was granted for famine in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yichou, the court granted famine relief in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，賜沈懋學等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, day yisi: jinshi titles, palace degrees, and provincial degrees were granted to Shen Maoxue and others according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yisi, the palace examination was held; Shen Maoxue and others received jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and provincial degrees according to merit.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸巳，廣東羅旁瑤平。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day guisi: the Luopang Yao of Guangdong were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on guisi, the Luopang Yao of Guangdong were pacified.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸亥，河復決崔鎮。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day guihai: the Yellow River breached again at Cuizhen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on guihai, the Yellow River breached again at Cuizhen.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙酉朔，日食，陰雲不見。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day yiyou new moon: there was a solar eclipse, but clouds obscured it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the intercalary month there was a solar eclipse, but clouds hid it from view.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，起復張居正。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jimao: Zhang Juzheng was recalled from mourning to resume office.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jimao, Zhang Juzheng was recalled from mourning to resume office.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙巳，以論張居正奪情，杖編修吳中行、檢討趙用賢、員外郎艾穆、主事沈思孝，罷黜謫戍有差。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yisi: for memorializing against Zhang Juzheng's abbreviated mourning, Compiler Wu Zhongxing, Proofreader Zhao Yongxian, Department Director Ai Mu, and Section Director Shen Sixiao were caned; dismissal, demotion, and exile varied by case.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yisi, for protesting Zhang Juzheng's return from mourning without completing filial rites, Compiler Wu Zhongxing, Proofreader Zhao Yongxian, Department Director Ai Mu, and Section Director Shen Sixiao were caned; they were dismissed, demoted, and exiled by degree.

sentences.zh: 丁未，杖進士鄒元標，戍邊。

translations.literal: On dingwei Jinshi Zou Yuanbiao was caned and exiled to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the jinshi Zou Yuanbiao was caned and exiled to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，以星變考察百官。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guichou: because of stellar anomalies officials were inspected.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guichou, because of stellar anomalies the court inspected officials.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月，築決河堤。

translations.literal: Year six, spring, first month: dikes were built where the river had breached.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Wanli six, in the first month, dikes were built where the river had breached.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，免兗、青、登、萊所屬逋賦。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuxu: arrears in prefectures Yan, Qing, Deng, and Lai were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuxu, tax arrears in Yan, Qing, Deng, and Lai were remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚子，立皇后王氏。

translations.literal: On gengzi Empress Wang was invested.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Empress Wang was invested.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，禮部尚書馬自強兼文淵閣大學士，吏部侍郎申時行兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiayin: Minister of Rites Ma Ziqiang was concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion; Vice Minister of Personnel Shen Shihang was concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion; both joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiayin, Ma Ziqiang, minister of rites, was also made grand secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion; Shen Shihang, vice minister of personnel, was also made grand secretary of the Eastern Pavilion; both entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 甲子，張居正葬父歸。

translations.literal: On jiazi Zhang Juzheng returned home to bury his father.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Zhang Juzheng returned home to bury his father.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，免湖廣、四川逋賦。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yiwei: arrears in Huguang and Sichuan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yiwei, tax arrears in Huguang and Sichuan were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔戶部歲增金花銀二十萬兩。

translations.literal: On bingwu an edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to increase gold-flower silver by two hundred thousand taels annually.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu an edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to increase the gold-flower silver levy by two hundred thousand taels each year.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未，張居正還京師。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yiwei: Zhang Juzheng returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yiwei, Zhang Juzheng returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，呂調陽致仕。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yimao: Lü Diaoyang retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yimao, Lü Diaoyang retired from office.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔江北諸府民，年十五以上無田者，官給牛一頭、田五十畝開墾，三年後起科。

translations.literal: On bingzi an edict ordered that for commoners in prefectures north of the Yangzi who were fifteen years or older and landless, the state would provide one ox and fifty mu of land for reclamation; taxation would begin after three years.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi an edict ordered that landless commoners fifteen years or older in Yangzi-north prefectures receive one ox and fifty mu of land for reclamation, with taxation to begin after three years.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，詔蘇州諸府開墾荒田，六年後起科。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengwu: an edict ordered reclamation of wasteland in Suzhou and other prefectures; taxation would begin after six years.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengwu, an edict ordered reclamation of wasteland in Suzhou and other prefectures, with taxation to begin after six years.

sentences.zh: 辛未，停刑。

translations.literal: On xinwei executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛卯，馬自強卒。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinmao: Ma Ziqiang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinmao, Ma Ziqiang died.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，禮天於南郊。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinyou: Heaven was sacrificed to at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinyou, the court sacrificed to Heaven at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 是年，烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year U-Tsang entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year U-Tsang sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月戊辰，詔毀天下書院。

translations.literal: Year seven, spring, first month, day wuchen: an edict ordered the destruction of academies throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Wanli seven, on wuchen of the first month, an edict ordered academies throughout the realm destroyed.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，遣使分閱邊防。

translations.literal: Second month, day jichou: envoys were dispatched to inspect frontier defenses separately.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jichou, envoys were dispatched to inspect frontier defenses separately.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，免淮、揚逋賦。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiazi: arrears in Huai and Yang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiazi, tax arrears in Huai and Yang were remitted.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸亥，祀地於北郊。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day guihai: the earth was sacrificed to at the Northern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on guihai, the court sacrificed to the earth at the Northern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯核兩畿、山東、陜西勛戚田賦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinmao: land tax levies on meritocratic kin in the Two Capitals region, Shandong, and Shaanxi were audited.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinmao, land tax levies on meritocratic kin in the Two Capitals region, Shandong, and Shaanxi were audited.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，振蘇、松水災，蠲稅糧。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renzi: relief was granted for flooding in Suzhou and Songjiang, and grain tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renzi, the court granted flood relief in Suzhou and Songjiang and remitted grain tax.

sentences.zh: 戊午，京師地震。

translations.literal: On wuwu the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 是年，烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year U-Tsang entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year U-Tsang sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 八年春二月辛未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Year eight, spring, second month, day xinwei new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Wanli eight, on the xinwei new moon of the second month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊子，耕耤田。

translations.literal: On wuzi the sacred field was plowed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，河工成。

translations.literal: On wuxu river works were completed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu work on the river was completed.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，奉兩宮皇太后如天壽山謁陵，免所過田租。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinhai: the two empresses dowager were escorted to Mount Tianshou to pay respects at the tombs, and field rent along the route was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinhai, the emperor escorted the two empresses dowager to Mount Tianshou to pay respects at the tombs, and field rent along the route was remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，還宮。

translations.literal: On jiayin he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賜張懋修等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On dingmao jinshi titles, palace degrees, and provincial degrees were granted to Zhang Maoxiu and others according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the palace examination was held; Zhang Maoxiu and others received jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and provincial degrees according to merit.

sentences.zh: 夏閏四月庚申，廣西八寨賊平。

translations.literal: Summer, intercalary fourth month, day gengshen: the bandits of Guangxi's Eight Stockades were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month of summer, on gengshen, the bandits of Guangxi's Eight Stockades were pacified.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛丑，汰內外冗官。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinchou: superfluous officials within and outside the court were weeded out.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinchou, superfluous officials within and outside the court were weeded out.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，振蘇、松、常、鎮饑。

translations.literal: On yisi relief was granted for famine in Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the court granted famine relief in Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，詔度民田。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingzi: an edict ordered a survey of commoners' fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingzi, an edict ordered a survey of commoners' fields.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月庚午，敕邊臣備警。

translations.literal: Year nine, spring, first month, day gengwu: border officials were ordered to prepare alerts.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Wanli nine, on gengwu of the first month, border officials were ordered to prepare alerts.

sentences.zh: 辛未，裁諸司冗官。

translations.literal: On xinwei superfluous officials in the various ministries were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei superfluous officials in the various ministries were reduced.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，土蠻犯錦州，遊擊周之望敗沒。

translations.literal: On guiyou the Tuman tribesmen raided Jinzhou; Guerrilla Commander Zhou Zhiwang was defeated and killed in action.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the Tuman raided Jinzhou; Guerrilla Commander Zhou Zhiwang was defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命翰林官日四人入直。

translations.literal: On jimao four Hanlin officials daily were ordered to attend duty at the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao four Hanlin officials daily were ordered to attend duty at the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，裁南京冗官。

translations.literal: On xinsi superfluous officials in Nanjing were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi superfluous officials in Nanjing were reduced.

sentences.zh: 甲申，遼東總兵官李成梁襲敗土蠻於襖郎兔。

translations.literal: On jiashen Li Chengliang, Commander-in-chief of Liaodong, launched a surprise attack and defeated the Tuman at Aolangtu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Li Chengliang, commander-in-chief of Liaodong, launched a surprise attack and defeated the Tuman at Aolangtu.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅，大閱。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingyin: a grand military review was held.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingyin, a grand military review was held.

sentences.zh: 是月，土蠻犯遼陽，副總兵曹簠禦之，敗績。

translations.literal: That month the Tuman raided Liaoyang; Vice Commander-in-chief Cao Dan defended against them but suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Tuman raided Liaoyang; Vice Commander-in-chief Cao Dan defended but was defeated.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，振山西被災州縣。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingyou: relief was granted in Shanxi prefectures and counties stricken by disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingyou, the court granted disaster relief in Shanxi prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，振蘇、松、淮、鳳、徐、宿災。

translations.literal: On yimao relief was granted for disasters in Suzhou, Songjiang, Huai, Feng, Xu, and Su.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the court granted disaster relief in Suzhou, Songjiang, Huai, Feng, Xu, and Su.

sentences.zh: 戶部進《萬歷會計錄》。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue presented the Wanli Accounts Record.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue presented the Wanli Accounts Record.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丁未，揚州大水。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day dingwei: Yangzhou suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on dingwei, Yangzhou suffered great flooding.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，停刑。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dinghai: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dinghai, executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥，土蠻犯廣寧、義州，李成梁禦卻之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jihai: the Tuman raided Guangning and Yizhou; Li Chengliang repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jihai, the Tuman raided Guangning and Yizhou; Li Chengliang repelled them.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，振真定、順德、廣平災，免稅糧。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingxu: relief was granted for disasters in Zhending, Shunde, and Guangping, and grain tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingxu, the court granted disaster relief in Zhending, Shunde, and Guangping and remitted grain tax.

sentences.zh: 是年，裁各省冗官，核徭賦，汰諸司冒濫冗費。

translations.literal: That year superfluous officials in the provinces were reduced, corvée and tax levies were audited, and fraudulently inflated redundant expenses in the ministries were cut.
translations.idiomatic: That year superfluous provincial officials were reduced, corvée and tax levies were audited, and fraudulently inflated redundant ministry expenses were cut.

sentences.zh: 琉球、安南、土魯番、天方、撒馬兒罕、魯迷、哈密、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu, Annam, Turpan, Tianfang, Samarkand, Rumi, Hami, and U-Tsang entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ryukyu, Annam, Turpan, Tianfang, Samarkand, Rumi, Hami, and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 十年春二月癸巳，順義王俺答卒。

translations.literal: Year ten, spring, second month, day guisi: Anda, Prince of Shunyi, died.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Wanli ten, on guisi of the second month, Anda, Prince of Shunyi, died.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，免天下積年逋賦。

translations.literal: On dingyou accumulated back taxes throughout the realm were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou accumulated tax arrears throughout the realm were remitted.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，杭州兵變，執巡撫吳善言。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengshen: a mutiny broke out among the troops at Hangzhou, and Grand Coordinator Wu Shanyan was seized.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengshen, troops at Hangzhou mutinied and seized Grand Coordinator Wu Shanyan.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，兵部侍郎張佳胤巡撫浙江，討定之。

translations.literal: On dingmao Zhang Jiayin, Vice Minister of War, was made grand coordinator of Zhejiang and put down the revolt.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Zhang Jiayin, vice minister of war, was made grand coordinator of Zhejiang and put down the revolt.

sentences.zh: 丙子，泰寧衛部長速把亥犯義州，李成梁擊斬之。

translations.literal: On bingzi Subutai, a chieftain of Taining Guard, raided Yizhou; Li Chengliang attacked and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Subutai, a chieftain of Taining Guard, raided Yizhou; Li Chengliang attacked and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 己卯，倭寇溫州。

translations.literal: On jimao Japanese pirates raided Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Japanese pirates raided Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子朔，諭禮部，令民及時農桑，勿事遊惰。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuzi new moon: the Ministry of Rites was instructed to order the people to attend to farming and sericulture in season and not indulge in wandering idleness.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi new moon of the fourth month of summer, the Ministry of Rites was instructed to order the people to attend to farming and sericulture in season and not indulge in wandering idleness.

sentences.zh: 甲午，寧夏土軍馬景殺參將許汝繼，巡撫都御史晉應槐討誅之。

translations.literal: On jiawu Ma Jing of the Ningxia native troops killed Assistant Commander Xu Ruji; Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-chief Jin Yinghuai led a punitive expedition and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Ma Jing of the Ningxia native troops killed Assistant Commander Xu Ruji; Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-chief Jin Yinghuai led a punitive expedition and executed him.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以久旱敕修省。

translations.literal: On gengzi, because of prolonged drought, an edict called for self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, because of prolonged drought, an edict called for self-examination and reform.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，免先師孔子及宋儒硃熹、李侗、羅從彥、蔡沈、胡安國、遊酢、真德秀、劉子翬，故大學士楊榮後裔賦役有差。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengshen: tax and corvée duties were remitted in varying degrees for the descendants of Master Confucius, the Song Neo-Confucians Zhu Xi, Li Tong, Luo Congyan, Cai Shen, Hu An'guo, You Zuo, Zhen Dexiu, and Liu Zihui, and for the descendants of the late Grand Secretary Yang Rong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengshen, tax and corvée duties were remitted in varying degrees for the descendants of Master Confucius, the Song Neo-Confucians Zhu Xi, Li Tong, Luo Congyan, Cai Shen, Hu An'guo, You Zuo, Zhen Dexiu, and Liu Zihui, and for the descendants of the late Grand Secretary Yang Rong.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，振畿內饑。

translations.literal: On gengchen relief was granted for famine within the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the court granted famine relief within the capital region.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dinghai new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai new moon of the sixth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，振太原、平陽、潞安饑。

translations.literal: On renyin relief was granted for famine in Taiyuan, Pingyang, and Lu'an.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the court granted famine relief in Taiyuan, Pingyang, and Lu'an.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，前禮部尚書潘晟兼武英殿大學士，吏部侍郎余有丁為禮部尚書兼文淵閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: On yisi the former Minister of Rites Pan Sheng was concurrently made Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall; Yu Youding, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made Minister of Rites and concurrent Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion; both joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the former minister of rites Pan Sheng was also made grand secretary of the Wuying Hall; Yu Youding, vice minister of personnel, was made minister of rites and also grand secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion; both entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 晟尋罷。

translations.literal: Pan Sheng was soon removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Sheng was soon removed from office.

sentences.zh: 丙午，張居正卒。

translations.literal: On bingwu Zhang Juzheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Zhang Juzheng died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，振平、慶、延、臨、鞏饑。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengwu: relief was granted for famine in Ping, Qing, Yan, Lin, and Gong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengwu, the court granted famine relief in Ping, Qing, Yan, Lin, and Gong.
