translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guimao: Heaven was sacrificed to at the southern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guimao, Heaven was sacrificed to at the southern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 是年，土魯番入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Turpan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Turpan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十五年春正月壬辰，發帑振山西、陜西、河南、山東諸宗室。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, spring, first month, day renchen: treasury funds were disbursed to provide relief to imperial clansmen in Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, in the first month of spring, on renchen, treasury funds were disbursed to relieve imperial clansmen in Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，乞慶哈子撦力克襲封順義王。

translations.literal: Third month, day yimao: Qiqingha's son Chelik succeeded as Prince of Shunyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yimao, Qiqingha's son Chelik succeeded as Prince of Shunyi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，京師旱，大疫。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: drought in the capital and a great epidemic.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer the capital suffered drought and a great epidemic.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，禁廷臣奢僭。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuchen: extravagance and presumptuous display by court officials were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuchen, extravagance and presumptuous display by court officials were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 是月，京師大雨。

translations.literal: That month, heavy rain in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That month heavy rain fell in the capital.

sentences.zh: 振恤貧民。

translations.literal: Relief was sent to assist the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Relief was sent to assist the poor.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，江北蝗，江南大水，山西、陜西、河南、山東旱，河決開封，蠲振有差。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: locusts in Jiangbei, great floods in Jiangnan, drought in Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, and Shandong; the Yellow River breached its banks at Kaifeng; remission of taxes and relief were granted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn locusts struck Jiangbei and great floods hit Jiangnan, while Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, and Shandong suffered drought; the Yellow River burst its banks at Kaifeng, and tax remissions and relief were granted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，以災沴頻仍，敕撫、按官懲貪吏，理冤獄，蠲租、振恤。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengshen: because disasters recurred frequently, an edict ordered regional and circuit inspectors to punish corrupt officials, redress wrongful cases, remit rents, and provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengshen, because disasters recurred frequently, an edict ordered regional and circuit inspectors to punish corrupt officials, redress wrongful cases, remit rents, and provide relief.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥朔，日當食，陰雲不見。

translations.literal: Ninth month, first day dinghai: an eclipse was due, but clouds blocked the view.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the first day of the ninth month, an eclipse was expected but could not be seen through the clouds.

sentences.zh: 己丑，停刑。

translations.literal: Day jichou: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，大學士申時行請發留中章奏。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengshen: Grand Secretary Shen Shixing requested that memorials held at court be released.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengshen, Grand Secretary Shen Shixing asked that memorials held at court be released.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，鄖陽兵噪，巡撫都御史李材罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuzi: troops at Yunyang mutinied noisily; Regional Inspector Li Cai was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuzi, troops at Yunyang mutinied, and Regional Inspector Li Cai was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 是年，哈密、琉球、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Hami, Ryukyu, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hami, Ryukyu, and U-Tsang sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十六年春三月壬辰，詔改《景皇帝實錄》，去郕戾王號，不果行。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year, spring, third month, day renchen: an edict ordered revision of the Veritable Records of the Jing Emperor to remove the title "Prince of Xiang, the Disobedient"; it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, in the third month of spring, on renchen, an edict ordered revision of the Veritable Records of the Jing Emperor to remove the title Prince of Xiang, the Disobedient, but this was not carried out.

sentences.zh: 山西、陜西、河南及南畿、浙江並大饑疫。

translations.literal: Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, the Southern Metropolitan Region, and Zhejiang all suffered great famine and epidemic.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi, Shaanxi, Henan, the Southern Metropolitan Region, and Zhejiang all suffered great famine and epidemic.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，振江北、大名、開封諸府饑。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: famine relief was sent to Jiangbei, Daming, Kaifeng, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer famine relief was sent to Jiangbei, Daming, Kaifeng, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 五月，四川建昌番作亂，討平之。

translations.literal: Fifth month: the Jianchang tribes in Sichuan rose in rebellion and were suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Jianchang tribes in Sichuan rose in rebellion and were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以軍儲倉火及各省災傷，敕內外官修省。

translations.literal: Day yisi: because of a fire at the military granary and disaster harm in various provinces, an edict ordered officials inside and outside the court to practice self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, because of a fire at the military granary and disaster harm in various provinces, an edict ordered officials throughout the realm to practice self-examination.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，京師地震。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengshen: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengshen, the capital shook with an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以災傷停減蘇、杭織造。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: because of disaster harm, Suzhou and Hangzhou weaving was suspended and reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Suzhou and Hangzhou weaving was suspended and reduced because of disaster harm.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，免山東被災夏稅。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yimao: summer taxes in disaster-stricken Shandong were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yimao, summer taxes in disaster-stricken Shandong were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚午，定邊臣考績法。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: a method for evaluating frontier officials' performance was established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu a method for evaluating frontier officials' performance was established.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，詔取太倉銀二十萬充閱陵賞費。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yiwei: an edict ordered 200,000 taels of silver from the Taicang treasuries for rewards at the tomb inspection.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiwei, an edict ordered two hundred thousand taels of silver from the Taicang treasuries for rewards during the tomb inspection.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，停刑。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiwei: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiwei, executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 庚申，如天壽山閱壽宮。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: went to Tianshou Mountain to inspect the longevity tomb-palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he went to Tianshou Mountain to inspect the longevity tomb-palace.

sentences.zh: 甲子，次石景山觀渾河。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: stopped at Shijingshan to view the Hun River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he stopped at Shijingshan to view the Hun River.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，還宮。

translations.literal: Day yichou: returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，甘肅兵變，巡撫都御史曹子登罷。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: mutiny in Gansu; Regional Inspector Cao Zideng was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu troops mutinied in Gansu and Regional Inspector Cao Zideng was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 是月，青海部長他不囊犯西寧，殺副將李魁。

translations.literal: That month, the Qinghai chieftain Tabunang invaded Xining and killed Vice Regional Commander Li Kui.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Qinghai chieftain Tabunang invaded Xining and killed Vice Regional Commander Li Kui.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛酉，禁章奏浮冗。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day xinyou: verbose and redundant memorials were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on xinyou, verbose and redundant memorials were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 是年，烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year U-Tsang sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十七年春正月己酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Seventeenth year, spring, first month, first day jiyou: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, on jiyou, the first day of the first month of spring, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太湖、宿、松賊劉汝國等作亂，安慶指揮陳越討之，敗死。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: the bandits Liu Ruguo and others rose around Taihu, Su, and Song; Chen Yue, commandant of Anqing, attacked them and was defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the bandits Liu Ruguo and others rose around Taihu, Su, and Song; Chen Yue, commandant of Anqing, attacked them and was defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，吳淞指揮陳懋功討平之。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingshen: Chen Maogong, commandant of Wusong, suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingshen, Chen Maogong, commandant of Wusong, suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，免升授官面謝。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingchen: newly promoted officials were exempted from appearing in person to give thanks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingchen, newly promoted officials were exempted from appearing in person to give thanks.

sentences.zh: 自是臨御遂簡。

translations.literal: From this point audiences at court became brief.
translations.idiomatic: From this point audiences at court became brief.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，雲南永昌兵變。

translations.literal: Day guihai: mutiny at Yongchang in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai troops mutinied at Yongchang in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賜焦竑等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Day yichou: jinshi titles, palace degrees, and various provincial degrees were granted to Jiao Hong and others.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Jiao Hong and others received jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and provincial degrees according to merit.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，王家屏復入閣。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jihai: Wang Jiaping reentered the inner cabinet.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jihai, Wang Jiaping reentered the inner cabinet.

sentences.zh: 始興妖僧李圓朗作亂，犯南雄，有司討誅之。

translations.literal: The demonic monk Li Yuanlang rose in Shixing, invaded Nanxiong, and was hunted down and executed by local officials.
translations.idiomatic: The demonic monk Li Yuanlang rose in Shixing, invaded Nanxiong, and was hunted down and executed by local officials.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，浙江大風，海溢。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiashen: great winds in Zhejiang and flooding from the sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiashen, great winds struck Zhejiang and the sea overflowed its banks.

sentences.zh: 己丑，永昌亂卒平。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the mutinous troops at Yongchang were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the mutinous troops at Yongchang were pacified.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，南畿、浙江大旱，太湖水涸，發帑金四十萬振之。

translations.literal: Day yisi: great drought in the Southern Metropolitan Region and Zhejiang; Tai Lake dried up; 400,000 taels from the treasury were disbursed for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the Southern Metropolitan Region and Zhejiang suffered great drought, Tai Lake dried up, and four hundred thousand taels from the treasury were disbursed for relief.

sentences.zh: 秋八月壬寅，嚴匿名揭之禁。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day renyin: anonymous placards were strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on renyin, anonymous placards were strictly forbidden.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，停刑。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guiwei: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guiwei, executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，黃河決口工成。

translations.literal: Day guimao: work on the Yellow River breach was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao work on the Yellow River breach was completed.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，諭諸臣遇事勿得忿爭求勝。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jichou: officials were admonished that in handling affairs they must not contend in anger and seek victory.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jichou, officials were admonished not to meet affairs with angry contention and the urge to prevail.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Annam and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 十八年春正月甲辰朔，召見大學士申時行等於毓德宮，出皇長子見之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, spring, first month, day jiachen, new moon: Grand Secretaries including Shen Shixing were summoned to Yude Palace, and the eldest imperial son was brought out to be seen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, on the new moon of jiachen in the first month of spring, Grand Secretaries including Shen Shixing were summoned to Yude Palace, and the eldest imperial son was presented before them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，振湖廣饑。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiashen: famine relief was provided in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiashen, famine relief was sent to Huguang.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，免畿內被災夏稅。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jimao: summer tax in the capital region stricken by disaster was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jimao, summer tax was forgiven in the disaster-stricken capital region.

sentences.zh: 甲申，青海部長火落赤犯舊洮州，副總兵李聯芳敗沒。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Huolochi, chief of the Qinghai tribes, invaded Old Taozhou; Assistant Regional Commander Li Lianfang was defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Huolochi, chief of the Qinghai tribes, invaded Old Taozhou, and Assistant Regional Commander Li Lianfang was defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，更定宗籓事例，始聽無爵者得自便。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: regulations for the imperial clans were revised, and for the first time those without titles were allowed to come and go as they pleased.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou regulations governing the imperial clans were revised, and for the first time clansmen without titles were allowed to come and go freely.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengzi, new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the new moon of gengzi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，召見閣臣議邊事，命廷臣舉將材。

translations.literal: Day yichou: grand secretaries were summoned to discuss border affairs, and court officials were ordered to recommend men of military talent.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou grand secretaries were summoned to discuss border affairs, and court officials were ordered to recommend capable generals.

sentences.zh: 己巳，兵部尚書鄭雒經略陜西四鎮及山西、宣、大邊務。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Zheng Luo, Minister of War, was made strategic coordinator of the four garrisons of Shaanxi and of border affairs in Shanxi, Xuanfu, and Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Zheng Luo, minister of war, was appointed to oversee the four garrisons of Shaanxi and border affairs in Shanxi, Xuanfu, and Datong.

sentences.zh: 是月，火落赤再犯河州、臨洮，總兵官劉承嗣敗績。

translations.literal: That month, Huolochi again invaded Hezhou and Lintao; Regional Commander Liu Chengsi was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: That month Huolochi invaded Hezhou and Lintao again, and Regional Commander Liu Chengsi was defeated.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉，停撦力克市賞。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guiyou: border-market rewards for Chelik were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guiyou, border-market rewards for Chelik were suspended.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，振臨洮被兵軍民。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuyin: relief was provided to soldiers and civilians in Lintao harmed by warfare.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuyin, relief was sent to soldiers and civilians in Lintao harmed by warfare.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，遣廷臣九人閱邊。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiashen: nine court officials were dispatched to inspect the borders.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiashen, nine court officials were dispatched to inspect the borders.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 十九年春正月，頃甸寇永昌、騰越。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, spring, first month: Qing raiders attacked Yongchang and Tengyue.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, in the first month of spring, Qing raiders attacked Yongchang and Tengyue.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，總兵官尤繼先敗火落赤余眾於莽剌川。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiyou: Regional Commander You Jixian defeated the remaining forces of Huolochi at the Mangla River.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiyou, Regional Commander You Jixian defeated the remaining forces of Huolochi at the Mangla River.

sentences.zh: 閏三月丁丑，以彗星見，敕修省。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, day dingchou: because a comet appeared, an edict ordered self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary third month, on dingchou, a comet appeared and an edict called for self-examination and reform.

sentences.zh: 己卯以定天下之吉兇。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the auspicious and inauspicious signs for the realm were determined.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the auspicious and inauspicious signs for the realm were determined.

sentences.zh: 責給事中、御史風聞訕上，各奪俸一年。

translations.literal: Supervising secretaries and censors were blamed for rumor-mongering slander against the throne; each had one year's salary confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising secretaries and censors were punished for spreading rumors that slandered the throne; each had one year's salary confiscated.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申，享太廟。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingshen: sacrifice was offered at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingshen, sacrifice was offered at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 是後廟祀皆遣代。

translations.literal: Thereafter temple sacrifices were all performed by proxy.
translations.idiomatic: After this all temple sacrifices were performed by proxy.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，四川四哨番作亂，巡撫都御史李尚思討平之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renwu: the Four Sentry tribes in Sichuan rebelled; Grand Coordinator Li Shangsi suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renwu, the Four Sentry tribes in Sichuan rebelled, and Grand Coordinator Li Shangsi put them down.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，王錫爵歸省。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renzi: Wang Xijue returned home on leave.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renzi, Wang Xijue returned home on leave.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，諭廷臣，國是紛紜，致大臣爭欲乞身，此後有肆行誣蔑者重治。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guiwei: court officials were admonished that with state affairs in turmoil, great ministers were competing to request retirement, and henceforth those who recklessly slandered others would be severely punished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiwei, court officials were admonished that with state affairs in turmoil great ministers were competing to request retirement, and that henceforth anyone who recklessly slandered others would be severely punished.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，免河南被災田賦。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingyou: land tax in disaster-stricken Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingyou, land tax was forgiven in disaster-stricken Henan.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，許國致仕。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renshen: Xu Guo retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renshen, Xu Guo retired from office.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，申時行致仕。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Shen Shixing retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Shen Shixing retired from office.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，吏部侍郎趙志臯為禮部尚書，前禮部侍郎張位為吏部侍郎，並兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Vice Minister of Personnel Zhao Zhigao was made Minister of Rites, and former Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Wei was made Vice Minister of Personnel; both were concurrently made Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Lodge and joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Vice Minister of Personnel Zhao Zhigao was made minister of rites, and former Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Wei was made vice minister of personnel; both were also made grand secretaries of the Eastern Lodge and entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，京營軍官嘩於長安門。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guisi: capital garrison officers mutinied at Chang'an Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guisi, capital garrison officers mutinied at Chang'an Gate.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，詔定戚臣莊田。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiawu: an edict fixed the estate lands of consort kin.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiawu, an edict fixed the estate lands held by consort kin.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，河套部敵犯榆林、延綏，總兵官杜桐敗之。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Ordos enemies invaded Yulin and Yan-sui; Regional Commander Du Tong defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Ordos raiders invaded Yulin and Yan-sui, and Regional Commander Du Tong defeated them.

sentences.zh: 是年，畿內蝗，南畿、浙江大水，蠲振有差。

translations.literal: That year, locusts struck the capital region; the Southern Metropolitan Region and Zhejiang suffered great floods; tax remission and relief were granted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: That year locusts struck the capital region, the Southern Metropolitan Region and Zhejiang were hit by great floods, and tax remission and relief were granted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ryukyu sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月丙戌，給事中孟養浩以言建儲杖闕下，削籍。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, spring, first month, day bingxu: Supervising Secretary Meng Yanghao, for speaking on the establishment of the heir apparent, was beaten at the palace gate and expelled from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, in the first month of spring, on bingxu, Supervising Secretary Meng Yanghao was beaten at the palace gate and expelled from office for urging the establishment of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，寧夏致仕副總兵哱拜殺巡撫都御史黨馨、副使石繼芳，據城反。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuchen: Pai Bai, retired assistant regional commander of Ningxia, killed Grand Coordinator Dang Xin and Vice Commissioner Shi Jifang and seized the city in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuchen, Pai Bai, a retired assistant regional commander of Ningxia, killed Grand Coordinator Dang Xin and Vice Commissioner Shi Jifang and seized the city in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 辛未，王家屏致仕。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Wang Jiaping retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Wang Jiaping retired from office.

sentences.zh: 壬申，總督軍務兵部尚書魏學曾討寧夏賊。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Wei Xuezeng, Minister of War and overall commander of military affairs, campaigned against the Ningxia rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Wei Xuezeng, minister of war and overall commander of military affairs, marched to suppress the Ningxia rebels.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，賜翁正春等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: jinshi including Weng Zhengchun were granted ranks of passed and appointed with differing grades.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin jinshi including Weng Zhengchun received their degrees and appointments with differing grades.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，總兵官李如松提督陜西討賊軍務。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiachen: Regional Commander Li Rusong was made overall commander of Shaanxi forces for the campaign against the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiachen, Regional Commander Li Rusong was made overall commander of Shaanxi forces for the campaign against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，甘肅巡撫都御史葉夢熊帥師會魏學曾討賊。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Ye Mengxiong, Grand Coordinator of Gansu, led troops to join Wei Xuezeng in campaigning against the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Ye Mengxiong, grand coordinator of Gansu, led troops to join Wei Xuezeng in suppressing the rebels.

sentences.zh: 撦力克擒賊，叩關獻俘，復還二年市賞。

translations.literal: Chelik captured rebels, came to the border gate to present captives, and border-market rewards for two years were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Chelik captured rebels, came to the border gate to present captives, and border-market rewards for two years were restored to him.

sentences.zh: 五月，倭犯朝鮮，陷王京，朝鮮王李昖奔義州求救。

translations.literal: Fifth month: the Wo invaded Korea, took Wangjing, and King Yi Sun of Korea fled to Uiju to seek aid.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Japanese forces invaded Korea, captured Wangjing, and King Yi Sun fled to Uiju to seek aid.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，諸軍進次寧夏，賊誘河套部入犯，官軍擊卻之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingwei: the armies advanced and encamped at Ningxia; the rebels lured Ordos tribes to invade, and government troops drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingwei, the armies advanced and encamped at Ningxia; the rebels lured Ordos tribes to invade, and government troops drove them back.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，免陜西逋賦。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guiyou: overdue taxes in Shaanxi were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiyou, overdue taxes in Shaanxi were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，副總兵祖承訓帥師援朝鮮，與倭戰於平壤，敗績。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Assistant Regional Commander Zu Chengxun led troops to aid Korea and fought the Wo at Pyongyang; he was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Assistant Regional Commander Zu Chengxun led troops to aid Korea and fought the Japanese at Pyongyang, but was defeated.

sentences.zh: 甲申，罷三邊總督魏學曾，以葉夢熊代之，尋逮學曾下獄。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Three-Border Governor Wei Xuezeng was dismissed and replaced by Ye Mengxiong; soon Wei Xuezeng was arrested and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Three-Border Governor Wei Xuezeng was dismissed and replaced by Ye Mengxiong; soon afterward Wei Xuezeng was arrested and imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，兵部右侍郎宋應昌經略備倭軍務。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yisi: Song Yingchang, Vice Minister of War, was made strategic coordinator of forces prepared against the Wo.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yisi, Song Yingchang, vice minister of war, was appointed strategic coordinator of forces prepared against Japan.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔天下督撫舉將材。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: an edict ordered governors and grand coordinators throughout the empire to recommend men of military talent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou an edict ordered governors and grand coordinators throughout the empire to recommend capable generals.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，寧夏賊平。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renshen: the Ningxia rebels were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renshen, the Ningxia rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，李如松提督薊、遼、保定、山東軍務，充防海禦倭總兵官，救朝鮮。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renyin: Li Rusong was made overall commander of military affairs in Ji, Liaodong, Baoding, and Shandong, and appointed overall commander for coastal defense against the Wo, to rescue Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renyin, Li Rusong was made overall commander of military affairs in Ji, Liaodong, Baoding, and Shandong, and appointed overall commander for coastal defense against Japan to rescue Korea.

sentences.zh: 是月，振畿內、浙江、河南被災諸府蠲租有差。

translations.literal: That month, relief was provided to disaster-stricken prefectures in the capital region, Zhejiang, and Henan, and rents were remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: That month relief was sent to disaster-stricken prefectures in the capital region, Zhejiang, and Henan, and rents were forgiven in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊辰，御午門，受寧夏俘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuchen: the Emperor took the throne at the Meridian Gate and received Ningxia captives.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuchen, the emperor took the throne at the Meridian Gate and received Ningxia captives.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，以寧夏賊平，告天下。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiawu: because the Ningxia rebels had been pacified, the victory was announced to the empire.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiawu, with the Ningxia rebels pacified, the victory was announced to the empire.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、土魯番入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Siam and Turfan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Siam and Turfan sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月甲戌，李如松攻倭於平壤，克之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, spring, first month, day jiaxu: Li Rusong attacked the Wo at Pyongyang and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, in the first month of spring, on jiaxu, Li Rusong attacked the Japanese at Pyongyang and captured the city.

sentences.zh: 辛未，王錫爵還朝。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: Wang Xijue returned to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Wang Xijue returned to court.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔並封三皇子為王，廷臣力爭，尋報罷。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: an edict ordered the three princes to be enfeoffed as kings together; court officials protested vigorously, and the order was soon withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi an edict ordered the three princes to be enfeoffed as kings together; court officials protested vigorously, and the order was soon withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 壬午，李如松進攻王京，遇倭於碧蹄館，敗績。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Li Rusong pressed the attack on Wangjing, met the Wo at Pige, and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Li Rusong pressed the attack on Wangjing, met the Japanese at Pige, and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，敕勞東征將士。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiayin: an edict commended the eastern campaign troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiayin, an edict commended the troops of the eastern campaign.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，倭棄王京遁。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guimao: the Wo abandoned Wangjing and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guimao, the Japanese abandoned Wangjing and fled.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，詔天下每歲夏月錄囚，減釋輕系，如兩京例。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingyou: an edict ordered that throughout the empire prisoners be reviewed each summer month, with lighter sentences reduced or released, following the practice of the two capitals.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingyou, an edict ordered that throughout the empire prisoners be reviewed each summer month, with lighter sentences reduced or released, following the practice of the two capitals.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，倭使小西飛請款。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the Wo envoy Konishi Yukinaga requested peace.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the Japanese envoy Konishi Yukinaga requested peace.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，召援朝鮮諸邊鎮兵還。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guichou: troops from the border garrisons sent to aid Korea were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guichou, troops from the border garrisons sent to aid Korea were recalled.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，慧星見，敕修省。

translations.literal: Day yimao: a comet appeared; an edict ordered self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao a comet appeared, and an edict called for self-examination and reform.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，以災異敕戒內外諸臣修舉實政。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingxu: because of calamities and portents, an edict admonished officials within and without the court to carry out genuine reforms.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingxu, because of calamities and portents an edict admonished officials within and without the court to carry out genuine reforms.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，停刑。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingshen: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingshen, executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，薊遼總督顧養謙兼理朝鮮事，召宋應昌、李如松還。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingchen: Gu Yangqian, Governor-General of Ji and Liaodong, was also put in charge of Korean affairs; Song Yingchang and Li Rusong were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingchen, Gu Yangqian, governor-general of Ji and Liaodong, was also put in charge of Korean affairs, and Song Yingchang and Li Rusong were recalled.

sentences.zh: 是年，振江北、湖廣、河南、浙江、山東饑。

translations.literal: That year, famine relief was provided in Jiangbei, Huguang, Henan, Zhejiang, and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: That year famine relief was sent to Jiangbei, Huguang, Henan, Zhejiang, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 河南礦賊大起。

translations.literal: Mine bandits rose on a great scale in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Mine bandits rose on a great scale in Henan.

sentences.zh: 烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: U-Tsang sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月己亥，詔以各省災傷，山東、河南、徐、淮尤甚，盜賊四起，有司玩愒，朝廷詔令不行。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, spring, first month, day jihai: an edict stated that with disasters and hardship in every province, Shandong, Henan, Xu, and Huai especially severe, bandits rising everywhere, and local officials negligent, court edicts were not being carried out.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, in the first month of spring, on jihai, an edict stated that with disasters and hardship in every province—Shandong, Henan, Xu, and Huai especially severe—bandits rising everywhere, and local officials negligent, court edicts were not being carried out.

sentences.zh: 自今以安民弭盜為撫按有司黜陟。

translations.literal: Henceforth the pacification of the people and suppression of bandits would be the standard for promotion and dismissal of grand coordinators and local officials.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth the pacification of the people and suppression of bandits would be the standard by which grand coordinators and local officials were promoted or dismissed.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，皇長子常洛出閣講學。

translations.literal: Second month, day guichou: the eldest imperial son Changluo left the palace to begin his studies.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guichou, the eldest imperial son Changluo left the palace to begin his studies.

sentences.zh: 甲子，遣使振河南，免田租。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: envoys were dispatched to provide famine relief in Henan, and land rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi envoys were dispatched to provide famine relief in Henan, and land rent was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯，詔修國史。

translations.literal: Third month, day guimao: an edict ordered the compilation of the national history.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guimao, an edict ordered the compilation of the national history.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiyou, new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the new moon of jiyou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，禮部尚書陳於陛、南京禮部尚書沈一貫並兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinmao: Chen Yulu, Minister of Rites, and Shen Yiguan, Minister of Rites at Nanjing, were both concurrently made Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Lodge and joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinmao, Chen Yulu, minister of rites, and Shen Yiguan, minister of rites at Nanjing, were both made grand secretaries of the Eastern Lodge and entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 庚子，王錫爵致仕。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Wang Xijue retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Wang Xijue retired from office.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，雷雨，西華門災。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiyou: thunder and rain struck; the Xihua Gate burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiyou, thunder and rain struck and the Xihua Gate burned.

sentences.zh: 敕修省。

translations.literal: An edict ordered self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: An edict called for self-examination and reform.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙申，河套部長失兔犯延綏。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingshen: Shitu, chief of the Ordos tribes, invaded Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingshen, Shitu, chief of the Ordos tribes, invaded Yan-sui.

sentences.zh: 是月，延綏總兵官麻貴敗河套部敵於下馬關。

translations.literal: That month, Ma Gui, regional commander of Yan-sui, defeated Ordos enemies at Xiamaguan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ma Gui, regional commander of Yan-sui, defeated Ordos raiders at Xiamaguan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，南京兵部右侍郎邢玠總督川、貴軍務，討播州宣慰使楊應龍。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiwei: Xing Jie, Vice Minister of War at Nanjing, was made overall commander of military affairs in Sichuan and Guizhou to campaign against Yang Yinglong, Pacification Commissioner of Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiwei, Xing Jie, vice minister of war at Nanjing, was made overall commander of military affairs in Sichuan and Guizhou to campaign against Yang Yinglong, pacification commissioner of Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔倭使入朝。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: an edict permitted Wo envoys to enter court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao an edict permitted Japanese envoys to enter court.

sentences.zh: 是月，炒花犯遼東，總兵官董一元敗之。

translations.literal: That month, Chaohua invaded Liaodong; Regional Commander Dong Yiyuan defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chaohua invaded Liaodong, and Regional Commander Dong Yiyuan defeated him.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 二十三年春正月癸卯，遣都督僉事李宗城、指揮楊方亨封平秀吉為日本國王。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, spring, first month, day guimao: Military Commissioner Li Zongcheng and Commander Yang Fangheng were dispatched to enfeoff Hideyoshi as King of Japan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, in the first month of spring, on guimao, Military Commissioner Li Zongcheng and Commander Yang Fangheng were dispatched to enfeoff Hideyoshi as king of Japan.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未，賜硃之蕃等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiwei: jinshi including Zhu Zhifan were granted ranks of passed and appointed with differing grades.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yiwei, jinshi including Zhu Zhifan received their degrees and appointments with differing grades.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丁酉，京師地震，敕修省。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day dingyou: the capital was shaken by an earthquake; an edict ordered self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on dingyou, the capital was shaken by an earthquake, and an edict called for self-examination and reform.

sentences.zh: 秋九月戊寅，青海部長永邵卜犯甘肅，參將達雲敗之。

translations.literal: Autumn, ninth month, day wuyin: Yongshaobu, chief of the Qinghai tribes, invaded Gansu; Regimental Commander Da Yun defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on wuyin, Yongshaobu, chief of the Qinghai tribes, invaded Gansu, and Regimental Commander Da Yun defeated him.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔復建文年號。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: an edict restored the Jianwen reign era.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou an edict restored the Jianwen reign era.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛未，湖廣災，蠲振有差。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day xinwei: because of disaster in Huguang, tax remission and relief were granted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on xinwei, because of disaster in Huguang tax remission and relief were granted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，大學士趙志臯等請發留中章奏，不報。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinchou: Grand Secretaries including Zhao Zhigao requested that memorials held at court be issued; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinchou, Grand Secretaries including Zhao Zhigao requested that memorials held at court be issued, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 是年，江北大水，淮溢，浸泗州祖陵。

translations.literal: That year, great floods struck Jiangbei; the Huai overflowed and inundated the imperial ancestral tombs at Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That year great floods struck Jiangbei; the Huai overflowed and inundated the imperial ancestral tombs at Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春二月戊申，麻貴襲河套部，敗之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, spring, second month, day wushen: Ma Gui raided the Ordos tribes and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, in the second month of spring, on wushen, Ma Gui raided the Ordos tribes and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，乾清、坤寧兩宮災，敕修省。

translations.literal: Third month, day yihai: the Qianqing and Kunning palaces burned; an edict ordered self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yihai, the Qianqing and Kunning palaces burned, and an edict called for self-examination and reform.

sentences.zh: 壬辰下詔自責。

translations.literal: Day renchen: an edict of self-reproach was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an edict of self-reproach was issued.

sentences.zh: 是月，火落赤犯洮河，總兵官劉綎破走之。

translations.literal: That month, Huolochi invaded the Tao River region; Regional Commander Liu Ting routed him.
translations.idiomatic: That month Huolochi invaded the Tao River region, and Regional Commander Liu Ting routed him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，李宗城自倭營奔還王京。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jihai: Li Zongcheng fled back to Wangjing from the Wo camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jihai, Li Zongcheng fled back to Wangjing from the Japanese camp.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰，河套部敵犯甘肅，總兵官楊浚擊破之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuchen: Ordos enemies invaded Gansu; Regional Commander Yang Jun defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuchen, Ordos raiders invaded Gansu, and Regional Commander Yang Jun defeated them.

sentences.zh: 庚午，復議封倭，命都督僉事楊方亨、遊擊沈惟敬往。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: enfeoffment of the Wo was again discussed, and Acting Regional Commander Yang Fangheng and Mobile Corps Commander Shen Weijing were ordered to go.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu enfeoffment of Japan was again discussed, and Acting Regional Commander Yang Fangheng and Mobile Corps Commander Shen Weijing were dispatched.

sentences.zh: 六月，振福建饑。

translations.literal: Sixth month: famine relief was provided in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month famine relief was sent to Fujian.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁卯，吏部尚書孫丕揚請發推補官員章疏，不報。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingmao: Sun Piyang, Minister of Personnel, requested that memorials on recommending and filling official vacancies be issued; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingmao, Sun Piyang, minister of personnel, requested that memorials on recommending and filling official vacancies be issued, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，仁聖皇太后崩。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the Empress Dowager Rensheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the Empress Dowager Rensheng died.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，始遣中官開礦於畿內。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: for the first time eunuch officials were sent to open mines within the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou eunuch officials were for the first time sent to open mines within the capital region.

sentences.zh: 未幾，河南、山東、山西、浙江、陜西悉令開采，以中官領之。

translations.literal: Before long Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, Zhejiang, and Shaanxi were all ordered to open mining operations, with eunuch officials placed in charge.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, Zhejiang, and Shaanxi were all ordered to open mines, with eunuch officials placed in charge.

sentences.zh: 群臣屢諫不聽。

translations.literal: The assembled ministers repeatedly remonstrated; [the emperor] did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The assembled ministers repeatedly remonstrated, but the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 閏八月乙丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Intercalary eighth month, day yichou, new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eighth month, on the new moon of yichou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，大學士趙志臯請視朝，發章奏，罷采礦，不報。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Grand Secretary Zhao Zhigao requested that the emperor hold court, issue pending memorials, and halt mining; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Grand Secretary Zhao Zhigao requested that the emperor hold court, issue pending memorials, and halt mining, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未，楊方亨至日本，平秀吉不受封，復侵朝鮮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yiwei: Yang Fangheng reached Japan; Hideyoshi refused the enfeoffment and again invaded Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yiwei, Yang Fangheng reached Japan, but Hideyoshi refused the enfeoffment and again invaded Korea.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，葬孝安莊皇后。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Empress Xia'an Zhuang was buried.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Empress Xia'an Zhuang was buried.

sentences.zh: 是月，河套部犯寧夏。

translations.literal: That month, the Ordos tribes invaded Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Ordos tribes invaded Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 總兵官李如柏擊敗之。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Li Rubei defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Li Rubei defeated them.

sentences.zh: 是秋，河決黃堌口。

translations.literal: That autumn, the Yellow River broke through at Huanggu Kou.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the Yellow River broke through at Huanggu Kou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，停刑。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingzi: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingzi, executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，始命中官榷稅通州。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: for the first time eunuch officials were ordered to levy transit taxes at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou eunuch officials were for the first time ordered to levy transit taxes at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 是後，各省皆設稅使。

translations.literal: Thereafter tax commissioners were established in every province.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter tax commissioners were established in every province.

sentences.zh: 群臣屢諫不聽。

translations.literal: The assembled ministers repeatedly remonstrated; [the emperor] did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The assembled ministers again remonstrated repeatedly, but the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥，陳於陛卒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yihai: Chen Yuzhai died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yihai, Chen Yuzhai died.
